# Terraform Cloudflare Security

> WAF rulesets, rate limiting, bot management, Turnstile, API Shield, and Page Shield.

Terraform module for Cloudflare, maintained by CloudDrove. Source: `terraform-cf-modules/security/cloudflare`. Repository: https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-security

Requires Terraform >= 1.12.0 (or OpenTofu >= 1.12) and the `cloudflare/cloudflare` provider ~> 5.24. Provider v5 renamed most resources from v4, so verify resource names against the current provider docs rather than older examples.

## Usage

```hcl
module "this" {
  source  = "terraform-cf-modules/security/cloudflare"
  version = "~> 0.1"
}
```

## Submodules

Each is separately addressable with the double slash source syntax.

- [api-shield](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-security/tree/main/modules/api-shield): `terraform-cf-modules/security/cloudflare//modules/api-shield`
- [bot-management](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-security/tree/main/modules/bot-management): `terraform-cf-modules/security/cloudflare//modules/bot-management`
- [firewall-legacy](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-security/tree/main/modules/firewall-legacy): `terraform-cf-modules/security/cloudflare//modules/firewall-legacy`
- [list](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-security/tree/main/modules/list): `terraform-cf-modules/security/cloudflare//modules/list`
- [page-shield](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-security/tree/main/modules/page-shield): `terraform-cf-modules/security/cloudflare//modules/page-shield`
- [rate-limit](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-security/tree/main/modules/rate-limit): `terraform-cf-modules/security/cloudflare//modules/rate-limit`
- [ruleset](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-security/tree/main/modules/ruleset): `terraform-cf-modules/security/cloudflare//modules/ruleset`
- [turnstile](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-cloudflare-security/tree/main/modules/turnstile): `terraform-cf-modules/security/cloudflare//modules/turnstile`
